svg.aria-label: Atlas drawn as a card-sorting line on a bench. A question card enters from a magazine, passes a guardrail gate with a reject tray, and is split into two parallel lanes: a magnet picker pulls dense-vector cards and a needle comb pulls keyword (BM25) cards from a shared drawer cabinet, the Qdrant index. A turntable collator fuses both rankings (RRF), a roller head for reranking stays lifted because both lanes agree, a stacker packs context under a stop collar (the token budget), a four-head turret with a cache drum and a limit spring is the LLM gateway, and a dial gauge checks citations before the lit answer sheet lands in the out tray. Behind, a second line feeds documents from a hopper through a scanner, a guillotine and an embosser into the cabinet.
svg.text: QUESTION IN AT LEFT · CITED ANSWER OUT AT RIGHT
back line: upload → parse → chunk → embed → index
Card magazine — question enters (console / REST / MCP)
Gate, flap, reject tray — guardrails: injection, PII, secrets
Splitter + two lanes — hybrid retrieval, run in parallel
Magnet picker | needle comb — dense vectors | BM25 sparse
Turntable collator — RRF fusion of both rankings
Roller head, lifted — adaptive rerank, skipped when top-1 agrees
Stacker under a stop collar — context assembly under a token budget
Turret, drum, spring — LLM gateway: fallback, cache, limits
Dial gauge, lit sheet — citation check, then the cited answer
